versions.changelog:
- Initial release of geekbi-shein-keyword-search-skill.
- Enables SHEIN keyword search and analysis using real data from 极鲸云.
- Supports keyword, hot-selling word, blue-ocean word, new word, and keyword opportunity searches.
- Analyzes recent 3-month and cumulative sales, demand trends, supply, competition, pricing, category, and market entry time.
- Strictly uses real data, follows site and category selection rules, and provides clear data boundaries and output requirements.
- Integrates with GeekBI SHEIN Skills shared login, supports pause/resume flow, and ensures results link directly to accurate sources.
